an3.130:1.1: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an3.130:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā anuruddho āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca :
an3.130:1.3: idāhaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sahassaṃ lokaṃ olokemi.
an3.130:1.4: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apamuṭṭhā. passaddho kāyo asāraddho. samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
an3.130:1.5: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatīti.
an3.130:2.1: [sāriputto:] yaṃ kho te āvuso anuruddha, evaṃ hoti :
an3.130:2.2: ‘evāhaṃ dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sahassaṃ lokaṃ olokemī’ti idante mānasmiṃ.
an3.130:2.3: yampi te āvuso anuruddha, evaṃ hoti :
an3.130:2.4: ‘āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā. passaddho kāyo asāraddho. samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagganti’ idante uddhaccasmiṃ.
an3.130:2.5: yampi te āvuso anuruddha, evaṃ hoti :
an3.130:2.6: ‘atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatī’ti, idante kukkuccasmiṃ.
an3.130:2.7: sādhu vatāyasmā anuruddho ime tayo dhamme pahāya ime tayo dhamme amanasikaritvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharatūti.
an3.130:3.1: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho aparena samayena ime tayo dhamme pahāya, ime tayo dhamme amanasikaritvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃhari.
an3.130:3.2: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
an3.130:3.3: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti abbhaññāsi.
an3.130:3.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā anuruddho arahataṃ ahosīti.
